brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to evaluate if supplementation with vitamin D in a dose of 40.000 IU per week will result in improved metabolic control in patients with type 2 diabetes.
brief_title: Vitamin D Supplementation to Patients With Type 2 Diabetes

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Type 2 diabetes for at least 1 year
* age 21-75 years
* long-acting insulin at bedtime
* metformin during the day
* for women of child bearing age use of reliable method of birth control

Exclusion Criteria:

* serum creatinine above 130 umol/l for men and above 110 for women
* systolic blood pressure \> 175 or diastolic \> 104 mmHg
* heart disease
* serum calcium \> 2.54 mmol/l
* history of renal stones

official_title: Vitamin D Supplementation to Patients With Type 2 Diabetes

sites.facility: Clinical Research Unit, University Hospital of North Norway
